value.title: Non mi arrenderò!
value.synopsis: At Kei's apartment a package from cyberdoll Mami filled with five "Chibi-Cyberdoll May's." After an accident causes May's personality to go into the five mini-May's, each one recieves distict aspect of her personallity. Elsewhere, Rena finds a lost child and brings it home. [This episode was included with the DVD set, and never aired]
